audit_metadata.title: Phase 35A — Existing-Data Generalization Strategy and Dataset Exposure Audit
audit_metadata.governance_note: No models trained, no scalers fitted, no hyperparameters tuned, no model checkpoints altered, no production defaults modified.

exposure_and_leakage_audit.temporal_proximity_leakage: 98.9% (1,122 / 1,134) of historical validation frames occur within <= 5 seconds of a training frame in the same session.
exposure_and_leakage_audit.verdict: Historical validation split is severely contaminated by temporal proximity and session overlap. Historical validation metrics (>90%) are uninformative regarding generalization.

capture_conditions: condition_1 (indoor overhead, plain wall, frontal eye-level)
historical_use: Phases 14-23 benchmark evaluations (YOLO baseline, MediaPipe CNN, Landmark RF v1/v2, Hybrid Concatenation RF)
Late fusion alpha parameter tuning (alpha=0.25 vs alpha=0.75)

exposure_and_leakage_audit.prior_development_influence: Heavily exposed during historical evaluation. Model selection choices (including Model C selection over Landmark v2) and fusion weight selection were directly informed by signer_02/03 benchmark performance.
exposure_and_leakage_audit.verdict: Cannot be characterized as a pristine unseen holdout. Useful only as a locked historical reference benchmark.

capture_conditions: condition_1 (indoor overhead, plain wall, frontal eye-level)
historical_use: Phases 14-23 benchmarking and late fusion comparison

exposure_and_leakage_audit.prior_development_influence: Co-benchmarked with signer_02 across all Phase 14-23 iterations. Prior metrics directly influenced architectural decisions.
exposure_and_leakage_audit.verdict: Exposed historical benchmark. Strictly quarantined from any future training or parameter optimization.

condition_1.description: indoor overhead, plain wall, frontal eye-level, ~75cm

historical_use: Phase 22 Split 1 development: 809 frames in training subset, 812 frames in validation subset for hyperparameter tuning
Phase 22 production training: ALL 1,621 usable frames pooled into the training set of Model C (phase22_analysis/models/Model_C_Occlusion_Aware_RF_multisigner.joblib)
Scaler fitting: phase22_analysis/models/Model_C_Occlusion_Aware_RF_multisigner_scaler.joblib fit on combined signer_01 (3,077) + signer_04 (1,621) samples

exposure_and_leakage_audit.prior_development_influence: Maximum exposure. All usable frames were incorporated into the authoritative production checkpoint.
exposure_and_leakage_audit.verdict: Signer_04 is development data. Any split derived from signer_04 evaluates recording robustness or cross-condition robustness within a known signer, NOT unseen-signer generalization.

governance_restrictions.reporting_requirement: All evaluation results on signer_04 MUST be explicitly labeled as 'Same-Signer Recording-Disjoint Validation' or 'Cross-Condition Robustness (Known Signer)'. NEVER claim unseen-signer generalization.

split_1_alternating_balanced.rule: Group strictly by recording_id. Letters A-M in Condition 1 and N-Z in Condition 2 assigned to Train; Letters A-M in Condition 2 and N-Z in Condition 1 assigned to Val.
split_1_alternating_balanced.evaluation_nature: Same-signer recording-disjoint and cross-condition robustness with balanced letter and condition distributions.

split_2_pure_cross_condition.rule: Condition 1 (frontal) assigned to Train; Condition 2 (lateral/distance) assigned to Val.
split_2_pure_cross_condition.evaluation_nature: Same-signer pure cross-condition angle/lighting transfer robustness.

capture_conditions.condition_1: indoor overhead, plain wall, frontal eye-level, ~75cm (26 recordings, 819 frames)
capture_conditions.condition_2: lateral ~15 deg angle, distance ~85cm (26 recordings, 819 frames)

historical_use: Phase 30 independent holdout evaluation: top-1 accuracy 59.22%, macro-F1 55.12%, 4 zero-recall classes (J, O, P, Q)

Phase 31 error forensics: detailed root-cause attribution into 6 failure mechanisms (coordinate rotation invariance, lap-hand threshold, screen x ordering, perspective inversion, self-occlusion, dynamic sign frame limit)

exposure_and_leakage_audit.prior_development_influence: Signer_05 was NOT used for training weights or fitting scalers. However, its exact failure modes, confusing classes, coordinate distributions, and error frames are fully known and documented in Phase 30/31.
exposure_and_leakage_audit.verdict: Signer_05 CANNOT be treated as a pristine future holdout. Any algorithm or parameter tuned specifically to resolve the 6 Phase 31 root causes would be informed by prior test-set exposure. Must remain strictly sealed.

signer_06_to_11.verdict: Per user directive, physical data collection is permanently concluded. No new signers exist in the repository.
